user_clarification.applies_to: A position carried from a previous trading day
normalized_rules: Target protection must be available from market open.
If carried-contract opening market has crossed Target, book profit and exit.
Stop-loss protection must not blindly reuse and place prior-day SL at market open.
Evaluate new-day opening gap and carried-contract opening premium first.
If gap is adverse, wait until configured lifecycle recalculation time and calculate revised SL from strategy policy.
Fresh-entry Gap/Missed-Entry and carried-position SL recalculation are separate processes.
Gap favourability uses economic exposure, not only GAP_UP/GAP_DOWN.
Offline lifecycle may produce EXIT_REQUIRED or REVISED_SL_PLACEMENT_REQUIRED only; no broker mutation authority.
Exact recalculation time and revised-SL formula remain strategy-policy inputs.
